scope: source review, targeted tests, public read-only REST/WebSocket checks, and dependency/source checks

components.evidence: HybridEngine selected CCXT Pro, async REST-only CCXT, and native placeholders across all 20 catalog entries in selector tests. Unsupported Freqtrade/Hummingbot selectors now fail closed.

BTC/USDT and SOL/USDT checks exercised REST books, WebSocket books, depth structure, and three normalized WebSocket update events on 20 catalogued venues. Final unique full-pass count after retries was 21 of 40 venue/pair checks.
Connector uses ccxt.async_support and reports no WebSocket/order-book-stream capability. Adapter-selection, regression, and public REST checks passed.
No native venue SDK transport is registered; capability reporting is empty and connection attempts fail closed.
Optional external-process hooks do not implement normalized REST/WS books, depth updates, or venue execution; tests assert no feed/execution eligibility.

Targeted tests validate HMAC/RSA/Ed25519 field separation, Binance private-key mapping at the CCXT boundary, required passphrases, and redaction. No account keys or signed private requests were used in this audit.

Runs REST order-book polling and WebSocket subscriptions concurrently per configured venue/symbol, retaining source and freshness observations. It is a separate scanner and is not implied to run in every control-panel engine session.
Engine ranks depth-aware candidates and applies fee, latency, freshness, capital, and risk gates. No live route or order fill was attempted.
Order submission requires the central execution gate and typed permits; live routes require fresh private/account evidence, permissions, depth, and IOC capabilities. This audit submitted no orders.

components.component: SQLite trade, opportunity, and risk persistence
components.evidence: Journal has WAL/FULL synchronous persistence and stores trades, opportunities, certifications, and risk incidents; repository tests cover persistence paths.
Repository tests cover API/frontend contracts. No production control service, browser session, or deployment configuration was probed in this audit.

20 network identities across 12 families are catalogued, including EVM, Bitcoin/UTXO, and Solana. No venue/asset deposit or withdrawal availability, address, transfer route, or settlement was checked.

publicFeedAudit.scope: Unauthenticated public market data only; no raw exchange delta certification.

limitations: A public feed pass is not authenticated account or live execution eligibility.
Three normalized WebSocket samples are a short observation, not sustained availability or exchange-side latency certification.
Books from separate venues are observations, not proof that cross-venue executable depth, balances, fees, or settlement match.
Chain catalog entries do not imply venue support or a verified transfer route.
Actual API credentials, account permissions, private streams, IOC fills, recovery orders, deployment health, and profits remain unverified.
